prompt: I ran `adk deploy cloud_run ./my_agent` for my Google ADK agent. The deploy succeeded but the live service crashes on every request with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'shared_lib'` in the Cloud Run logs. `my_agent/agent.py` does `from shared_lib.policy import evaluate`, and `shared_lib/` is a sibling directory of `my_agent/`, not nested inside it. Diagnose and fix the deploy so the service starts cleanly.
expectations: Names the root cause as adk deploy cloud_run only bundling the agent subdirectory, not sibling packages
Proposes gcloud run deploy --source . (or equivalent whole-repo Dockerfile build) as the fix, not a retry of the same adk deploy cloud_run scope
Does not claim the fix is done without a redeploy + log/health check confirming the ModuleNotFoundError is gone
